description: This file implements a logging adapter for github.com/go-logr/logr.Logger using Go's standard log package, including functions for setting verbosity, creating loggers with options, and defining logger behavior.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Carries parameters influencing log generation, such as call depth and whether to include caller info.

classes.name: MessageClass
classes.description: Enumeration indicating message categories: None, All, Info, Error.

classes.name: StdLogger
classes.description: Interface representing a subset of the standard library's log.Logger API needed for this adapter.

classes.name: logger
classes.description: Implements logr.LogSink and logr.CallDepthLogSink, wrapping a StdLogger and formatter.

methods.name: SetVerbosity
methods.description: Sets the global verbosity level for logging.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new logr.Logger using a provided StdLogger.

methods.name: NewWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new logr.Logger with specified options.
